import re,html,pathlib
s=pathlib.Path('products/services/sponsored-challenge/sources/drivendata-competitions.html').read_text(errors='replace')
s=re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style).*?</\1>',' ',s)
links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href="(/competitions/[^"]+)"',s)))
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s))
t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
out=pathlib.Path('products/services/sponsored-challenge/sources/drivendata-extract.txt')
out.write_text('LINKS\n'+'\n'.join(links[:80])+'\n\nTEXT\n'+t[:9000])
print(len(links)); print(t[:6000])
